factual_claims.claim: The weaker financial results were primarily caused by operational disruptions and external market factors.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The results for the Q1 2026 were negatively impacted by the scheduled shutdown... as well as by a significant increase in gas prices... The EBITDA for Q1 2026 was impacted by the commissioning of the new gas boiler house... and by cold weather conditions... In late February, the US military attack on Iran caused a sharp increase in energy prices.

factual_claims.claim: Specifically, the company's results were negatively impacted by the scheduled factory shutdown in early January for the transition to a new boiler house, the subsequent two-month calibration and start-up period of the new gas boiler house, and abnormally cold weather conditions that increased energy consumption.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The results for the Q1 2026 were negatively impacted by the scheduled shutdown of the factory in early January... The EBITDA for Q1 2026 was impacted by the commissioning of the new gas boiler house, the calibration and start-up of which took approximately two months, as well as by cold weather conditions, which increased normal energy consumption.

factual_claims.claim: Furthermore, in late February, geopolitical tensions caused a sharp spike in energy prices, nearly doubling the market price of gas.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: In late February, the US military attack on Iran caused a sharp increase in energy prices, with the market price of gas nearly doubling.

factual_claims.claim: Although gas prices subsequently fell, they remained approximately 50% higher than at the beginning of the year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Gas prices have since fallen, but remain approximately 50% higher than at the beginning of the year.
